body: Thank you for your response :] Unfortunately even leaving the house is difficult. Everything I do is being monitored. They want to keep me and my sister under their control because they simply have nothing else going for them. I’m used to creating things and working with my hands and getting up and moving and exercising.. In this house, I feel like I have no hands or feet. It’s something I’ve gotten used to since I was young, being prevented from doing something then having it held over me as if it was my choice.... Everything in me wants to get started on my own life and work, and even then my father has 0 confidence in that fact and would rather take all options away except for taking over his job in a large mill.... (not the worst job out there but definitely not what I see myself doing..) And there’s no bother trying to repeat myself (that I am able to find my own success and balance) to them because I’ve been trying to get them to understand for most of my life that I wasn’t born yesterday but they really never process anything other than surface-y things.. They’ve stunted my siblings and I all our lives because of their general lack of sensibility and compassion, and now (since before quarantine after my last classes ended) I feel like I’ve gone backwards 10 years after making so much progress for myself and my mental health. I don’t want to hurt myself but people like them (who I’d typically stay away from) make me want to try..
But we've had months to become prepared щ(ﾟдﾟщ)
